rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material template: both letters accept a Cabinet secretary's resignation, praise the official's substantive achievements, welcome a named successor who will preserve continuity, anticipate calling on the departing official for future assistance, and close with personal regard. C18 and C08 share several elements, especially praise, continued consultation, and warm personal wishes, but neither matches the child's full sequence as closely as C13.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I join with you in gratification that Arthur Flemming can succeed you, and carry forward without interruption the vital work in which you have been engaged.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I share your satisfaction that Robert Anderson has been able to accept my nomination as the individual to take over your duties... he will continue to follow the general path that you have so clearly marked out.
shared_material.explanation: Both insert a successor-focused paragraph emphasizing continuity with the resigning secretary's work.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There will be many occasions, I am sure, when we will have need to consult with you in the months ahead, and I am indeed grateful that you will be available for such continued assistance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Finally, I am grateful to you for your offer of future assistance to the Administration. From time to time I know we shall want to call upon you for advice and counsel
shared_material.explanation: This is a close verbal and functional parallel promising future consultation and thanking the departing official for remaining available.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I emphasize my gratitude for the wisdom and experience that you have brought to the deliberations of this Administration
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It would be idle to attempt expression of my feelings of gratitude for the extraordinary talents that... you brought to the Treasury Department
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the acceptance through gratitude for qualities the secretary brought to government service.
